name: Learn to row with Walton Rowing Club
summary: Walton Rowing Club has a long association with this stretch of the Thames and runs learn-to-row opportunities for adults and younger rowers — a course or club activity rather than a turn-up attraction, but a distinctive way to become active on the river.
reasonToVisit: Learn to row on the Thames with a long-established local club
